module_summary: AXI read-to-RAM adapter: an idle/burst FSM latches the AR request and issues one RAM read command per beat with incrementing address and beat counter, while RAM responses pass to the AXI R channel through an optional pipeline register.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Idle/burst FSM accepting AR requests and sequencing per-beat RAM commands.

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AR request valid starting a burst in idle.

anchors.name: s_axi_arready
anchors.why: AR ready, high in idle until request accepted.

anchors.name: s_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Burst start address latched into read_addr_reg.

anchors.name: read_addr_reg
anchors.why: Current beat address, incremented by size each accepted command.

anchors.name: read_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining beats in burst, loaded from arlen; ends burst at zero.

anchors.name: read_burst_reg
anchors.why: Latched burst type controlling address increment.

anchors.name: read_size_reg
anchors.why: Clamped beat size used as address increment step.

anchors.name: read_id_reg
anchors.why: Latched transaction ID driving RAM command ID.

anchors.name: read_last_reg
anchors.why: Marks last beat of burst on RAM command.

anchors.name: ram_rd_cmd_en
anchors.why: RAM read command valid driven by read_addr_valid_reg.

anchors.name: ram_rd_cmd_ready
anchors.why: RAM command ready advancing address and beat count.

anchors.name: ram_rd_cmd_addr
anchors.why: RAM read command address output.

anchors.name: ram_rd_resp_data
anchors.why: RAM read response data forwarded to AXI R channel.

anchors.name: ram_rd_resp_valid
anchors.why: RAM response valid forwarded as s_axi_rvalid.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata
anchors.why: AXI read data from RAM response or pipeline register.

anchors.name: s_axi_rready
anchors.why: AXI R ready backpressuring RAM responses and pipeline register.

anchors.name: ram_rd_resp_ready
anchors.why: Response ready to RAM from s_axi_rready or empty pipe.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata_pipe_reg
anchors.why: Optional output pipeline data register, unused when PIPELINE_OUTPUT=0.

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid_pipe_reg
anchors.why: Optional output pipeline valid register.

groups.name: Burst controller
groups.description: FSM accepting AR and counting beats of the RAM read burst.

groups.name: Address generator
groups.description: Holds request attributes and increments address per beat.

groups.name: RAM command port
groups.description: Issues per-beat RAM read commands with valid/ready.

groups.name: Read response path
groups.description: Forwards RAM responses to AXI R, optionally via pipeline registers.
